asks.prompt: Does a trade become allowable as soon as gate 1 (strategy) says YES?

options.label: Yes
options.feedback: Gate 1 only answers “does the setup exist?”.

options.label: No
options.why: Setup validity and participation eligibility are separate. Every gate has to clear.

lines: GOOD RULES DON’T PREDICT THE MARKET.
THEY CONTROL YOUR RESPONSE TO IT.

slides.quote: The market is allowed to be uncertain. Your operating system isn’t.

slides.prompt: Why do you need rules beyond the entry model?
slides.modelAnswer: Because the entry model only answers whether the setup exists. Rules for risk, session, news, max trades and no chasing decide whether I’m allowed to participate, so I’m not inventing decisions live.

takeaways: Awareness is step one. Rules protect you next.
Rules remove live decisions, not uncertainty.
Strategy → account → rulebook → execute or pass.
remember: DECIDE YOUR RULES BEFORE YOUR EMOTIONS NEED THEM.
